iES28GF Test Report
Date: 6/10/21
Summary
This test report includes data for the following switches:
Model # iES28GF-L2-HV-XX-RR-2MMSC2-8GRJ45-8GRJ45-XX
Serial # 28GF2321-00001
MAC E8E8750051DD
Description R: iES28GF-L2-HV-XX-RR-2MMSC2-8GRJ45-8GRJ45-XX
 Burn In Test  Functional Test  Hi Pot Test
Functional Test
Functional testing was performed on the unit to confirm proper operation of all Ethernet
ports, console port, LEDs, power supplies and relay.
Burn In Test
Burn-in testing was performed on the unit over a temperature cycle of -40 to +85°C. Cold-
start capability was also checked (power up at -40°C ambient).
Hi Pot Test
Hi-Pot Testing to 1.5kVAC for 10 seconds was performed on the unit.
